text:
Asha (PM): sharing new preflight idea: show host probes as a compact list with per-row inline retry and a collapsible detail card. need quick feedback on wording, focus, and bulk actions. figma: https://figma.com/file/placeholder

Ben (Design): compact rows + expandable detail sounds good. row shows name, small status pill, and meta (e.g., 18ms • TCP). expand reveals command snippet and 'Why this failed'.

Riley (Eng): implementation note: we'll run probes in parallel; include a 'last checked' timestamp per row. per-host retry only by default; 'Retry all failed' tucked into a kebab menu with confirmation. server will surface rate-limit flags.

Sam (A11y): accessibility concerns: move focus into expanded detail when opened and focus the first actionable control. use aria-expanded on rows. announce only the final summary (polite) and user-triggered results. avoid announcing each status change.

Asha (PM): copy question: status text options - 'Unreachable' vs "Can't reach host" vs 'No response'. prefer concise but clear.

Ben (Design): change to "Can't reach host" in the row; in details show 'No response (timeout)' when appropriate. buttons: 'Retry probe', 'Copy command', 'Show logs'. keep verbs consistent.

Riley (Eng): for retries, enforce client-side exponential backoff and show cooldown UI (e.g., disabled button with 'Retry in 28s'). also show a tiny inline spinner on retrying rows. limit to 3 attempts in UI.

Sam (A11y): ensure cooldown state is announced once: 'Retry disabled, try again in 28 seconds'. tooltips must be keyboard accessible and have aria-describedby. color cannot be the sole status indicator.

Asha (PM): error presentation: neutral summary banner 'Checks complete – 6 reachable, 2 need attention' (amber) instead of a full-page red. expand-to-card shows one-line cause, a single recommended step and a copyable command snippet like `nc -vz 10.0.3.7 8800` with accessible copy button.

infra-bot: deploy-preview ready -> https://deploy/preview/2468 (staging)

Ben (Design): one more microcopy: change 'run from a machine in the same network' -> 'run from a host in the same VPC or VLAN' in KB.

Riley (Eng): add collapsed raw logs for SREs behind 'Show logs' (copyable). ensure logs are not expanded by default to reduce noise.

Asha (PM): action items: Ben updates mocks (rows + expandable details, neutral banner, cooldown UI), Sam to draft A11y checklist, Riley to wire retry flags and last-updated timestamps. I'll post updated figma + preview when done. Thanks everyone!
